transcription.text: Funny thing, everybody wants to be original, which is brave, considering most of us learned language from people who were already talking. Yeah, I've been stealing fire with her seats. I used to want my name carved deep in the door, big letter saying I was here before, not huge, not greedy, just, you know, tastefully immortal, a plaque would do, maybe brass, maybe somewhere near the snacks, because I worked on the thing till the thing worked back till my eyes went dry and my shoulders attacked. Till the song had teeth and the lion had feet till the tiny little engine could cross the street and then someone says nice, it moves on, three weeks of my life became six seconds and a thumb and a smile like thank you while inside a small account and set a fire to a chair, but I didn't build this from nothing at all, I borrowed the ladder, I borrowed the wall, I'm standing on shoulders and lending my bones, making a step out of the door, I own, maybe they won't know what it cost me to climb, but if they see further than the work did find, would still accept applause, I'm evolving, not dead, every song has ancestors humming in the floor, every painting has fingerprints under the door, every sentence I wrote has a village behind it, some teacher with patience, some poet with timing, some stranger online, who explained something twice while being called an idiot by a man named Iceman, this beautiful species, terrible comment sections of taken little pieces from a thousand kind hands of rhythm, from a busker, a wound from a friend of phrase from my father, a joke from regret, a chord from a song, I pretended to forget, none of it means the making was hollow, it means I was fed before I learned how to swallow, it means I found a path because others wore ground, means the map had names, even when I looked down, so yes, put me in the footnotes, small print, back page near the typo, I wave, I'm standing on shoulders and lending my bones, making a step out of all I own, maybe they won't know what it calls me to climb, but if they see further than the word did find, and I won't pretend it doesn't sting, of course it stings, I'm not among, I'm the tired little creature with the password manager, in the approval issues, I want someone to notice the hours, the ugly drafts, the line I cut that deserved the small funeral, the chorus I rebuilt so many times, it started asking, for union rights, I want them to know I care, that I didn't just toss it into the world, like loose change, I carried a badly sometimes with snacks, but I carried it, and still, maybe love is letting the thing go without stapling your whole face to the front of it, maybe I is not always a monument, sometimes it's a bridge, that thanks you, but I be in crust, I like the idea of the open door, the shared shelf, that take this, make more, a recipe passed on with sauce on the page, a little note saying careful here, this bit breaks, that feels honest, that feels clean, not mine forever, just mine in between, like I found a crack cup and filled it with rain and left it by the path for whoever came, and maybe some kid with the second hand might take one little line and make something bright, maybe they never know my name or my doubt, maybe they build a house where I only marked out one nail, one bank, one awkward suggestion, one baggy lid, answer to a private question, and maybe that's enough, God, I hate how mature that sounds tragic, growth is terrible branding, let the work travel, but the name travel less, let the heart leave a handle for whoever comes next, I'm standing on shoulders and lending my bones, making a step out of all I own, maybe they won't know what it costs me to climb, but if they see further, then the work did fine, I'm not the first fire, I'm not the last flame, I'm one little match in the long human shame, if I am forgotten, but the song still gets through, then I was at all late, and someone walked through, so no, I didn't make this from nothing, nobody does, I made it from everything that made me, from hands I never thank, from names I mispronounced, from Bible courage and return mistakes, and maybe someday someone will step on this, not cruelly, just naturally, on their way to somewhere better, and I hope it holds, I hope it helps, I hope they don't look down too long, I hope they keep going, because maybe the point was never, look at me, maybe the point was here, stand here, you can see a little further.
